channel.description: Recent content on Software Engineer & Thinker

item.title: Tracing Tainted Data in Go Binaries with Intel Pin
item.description: A research proof of concept: tracking tainted string data through a compiled Go binary at the machine-code level using Intel Pin, with no source-level hooks.

item.title: GoldenMate BMS Reverse Engineering
item.description: Tearing down a GoldenMate battery management system: PCB analysis, firmware extraction over SWD, and Ghidra on an ARM Cortex-M0.

item.title: Harmonia
item.description: Multi-LLM triage for security scanner findings: sandboxed code reading, majority vote, tie adjudication, and CVSS 4.0 scoring.

item.title: AI Code Security: A Three-Tier Model for Secure AI-Generated Code
item.description: A working framework for AI code security: where AI coding agents get security right by default, where they need a nudge, and where gaps remain.

item.title: Too Many Cooks: When Agents Disagree, Security Can Suffer
item.description: Why multi-round AI code review can lead to security failures, and how to implement better governance in agentic development pipelines.

item.title: When AI Reviewers Cannot Agree
item.description: Why multi-round AI code reviews fail to converge, and how non-convergence serves as a critical stop signal for development teams.

item.title: Contaminated by Design: What Clinical Trials Can Teach AI Security Researchers
item.description: Why AI security research requires rigorous blinding protocols — including how environmental context bias and directory names alter AI agent behavior.
